caption: The video captures a close-up, static view of hands slicing a pale yellow root vegetable on a wooden cutting board. The hand on the right side of the frame holds the ingredient steady with curled fingers, while the other guides a silver knife in a repeated vertical slicing motion. The blade descends through the vegetable and lifts again, cutting thin pieces that fall away from the larger portion. As the rhythm continues, small slices accumulate on the left side of the main piece, forming a growing pile. The guiding hand remains mostly still, shifting only slightly to keep the vegetable in place beneath the blade. Light reflections travel across the metal surface with each up-and-down movement, while the background stays softly out of focus. Behind the board, blurred green stalks and a white bulbous object remain visible, framing the ongoing slicing.
